zh: 我通常八点半开始上班。
en: I {usually|normally|generally|typically} start work at half past eight.

zh: 请在签字前仔细阅读合同。
en: Please read the contract {carefully|thoroughly|closely} before you sign it.

zh: 其实，我觉得我们应该把截止日期往后推一周。
en: {Actually}, I think we should push the deadline back a week.

zh: 很遗憾，我们没有拿下那份合同。
en: {Unfortunately|Sadly}, we didn't win the contract.

zh: 我目前正在做季度报告。
en: I'm {currently} working on the quarterly report.

zh: 会议稍微超时了一点。
en: The meeting ran {slightly|a bit|a little} over time.

zh: 她很少错过截止日期。
en: She {rarely|seldom|hardly ever|almost never} misses a deadline.

zh: 听说经理月底要离职了。
en: {Apparently}, the manager is leaving at the end of the month.

zh: 我已经把议程发给你了。
en: I've {already} sent you the agenda.

zh: 我们得现在就走，否则见客户要迟到了。
en: We need to leave now, {otherwise|or|or else} we'll be late for the client meeting.

zh: 和新团队的交接进行得很顺利。
en: The handover to the new team went {smoothly|well}.

zh: 他开会总是提前到。
en: He {always} arrives early for meetings.

zh: 我周五多半会在家办公。
en: I'll {probably|most likely} be working from home on Friday.

zh: 基本上来说，我们需要更多人手才能按时完成。
en: {Basically|Essentially}, we need more people to finish this on time.

zh: 你的报告已经写完了吗？
en: Have you finished the report {yet}?

zh: 谈了很久，我们最终就价格达成了一致。
en: After a long discussion, we {eventually|finally} agreed on a price.

zh: 项目进度落后了。不过，客户还是很满意。
en: The project is behind schedule. {However|Nevertheless|Still|Even so}, the client is happy with our work.

zh: 不好意思，我回得太快了，没看到你的第二个问题。
en: Sorry, I replied too {quickly|fast} and missed your second question.

zh: 说真的，我一点也不介意今晚加班。
en: I {honestly|really|genuinely} don't mind staying late tonight.

zh: 每次发布，两个团队都紧密合作。
en: The two teams work {closely} together on every release.
